# 4. Prioritisation of Functionality – First Tranche (Year 1)

## Tranche 1 Objective

The first tranche focuses on establishing a minimum viable ecosystem workflow framework that demonstrates adaptability, reproducibility, FAIR compliance and practical applicability across multiple ecosystem indicator use cases. It delivers the foundation required for future workflow expansion while supporting the project's first reporting milestone and initial workflow deployment activities. [\[Attachment...oject Plan \| PDF\]](https://unsw-my.sharepoint.com/personal/z3529065_ad_unsw_edu_au/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/Attachment%201%20-%20PLT019%20Project%20Plan.pdf)

## Immediate Priorities (Mar–Sep 2026)

### WP2 – Workflow Planning

* Modular workflow architecture with documented swap points for:
  * ecosystem type
  * assessment purpose
  * indicator variables
  * data sources

Supports:

* UC01
* UC02
* UC07

### WP3 – Data and Metadata

* Pilot ecosystem map synthesis workflow
* Initial dataset inventory
* Initial vocabulary audit
* Dataset transformation and harmonisation tools

Supports:

* UC01
* UC05
* UC06

### WP4.1 – Initial Workflow Delivery

* Core workflow structure based on:
  * ecosystem data preparation
  * indicator data preparation
  * calculation
  * validation and uncertainty

Supports:

* UC01
* UC02
* UC03
* UC05

### WP6 – Community and Adoption

* Beginner-friendly quick-start guide
* Introductory workflow documentation
* Example workflow notebooks
* Initial workshop outputs

Supports:

* UC08
* UC09

# 5. Prioritisation of Functionality – Second Tranche (Year 2)

## Tranche 2 Objective

The second tranche expands the workflow ecosystem beyond individual workflows to support discoverability, scaling, interoperability and broader community adoption. The focus shifts from workflow creation to workflow reuse and operationalisation. [\[Attachment...oject Plan \| PDF\]](https://unsw-my.sharepoint.com/personal/z3529065_ad_unsw_edu_au/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/Attachment%201%20-%20PLT019%20Project%20Plan.pdf)

# 6. Review of Second Tranche Priorities

Consistent with the project plan, second-tranche requirements will be reviewed during the fourth quarter of Year 1 before commencement of WP4.2. The review will evaluate feedback from workflow users, workshop participants, ecosystem experts, and project partners to validate that Year 2 priorities continue to address the most important user needs. [\[Attachment...oject Plan \| PDF\]](https://unsw-my.sharepoint.com/personal/z3529065_ad_unsw_edu_au/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/Attachment%201%20-%20PLT019%20Project%20Plan.pdf)

The review will consider:

### User Adoption

* Which workflows are being reused?
* Which user groups are actively engaged?
* Which ecosystems are generating the greatest demand?

### Technical Performance

* Workflow reproducibility
* Data interoperability
* Platform performance
* FAIR compliance

### Community Feedback

* Feedback collected through workshops
* Community engagement activities
* User stories
* Steering Committee recommendations

### Emerging Use Cases

Potential additions may include:

* ecosystem accounting workflows
* TNFD-related reporting workflows
* Green Status of Ecosystems workflows
* ecosystem restoration workflows
* additional ecosystem realms and ecosystem types

Any approved changes to second-tranche priorities will be documented through the project's governance and change-control processes and reflected in the Year 2 delivery plan. [\[Attachment...oject Plan \| PDF\]](https://unsw-my.sharepoint.com/personal/z3529065_ad_unsw_edu_au/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/Attachment%201%20-%20PLT019%20Project%20Plan.pdf)
